name: Times cryptic crossword, Times Crosswords book 1 No 157

clue.text: Foreign character is in the money — high living for him
Sound of cat, one going round behind church — high-pitched sound
New resort suffering severe blow
Like pipe giving bath a litre
After search, carry off gun
Like pigs holding up rodent
As player who’s best at small part, be impatient to start acting
Manufacturer on river, one who’s competitive
Equipment as put out when soldier goes in
Specially trained horse breaking into gallop, ace runner
In sudden movement, ring is snatched from room
Bar snack?
Why late is bad — early makes you this
Like a purification ceremony artist left after deadly sin
Plain sort of pear, almost desiccated inside
Like Jacob, in more ways than one
Article on sex-appeal this girl shows
Opener apt to get excited, finding what’s in envelope
Job dispatching one East as nurse for relative
Really international woman
Religious leader’s interminable chatter
Small tree tot confused with maple
Despicable person’s minion liable to poison one
City person presiding, allowing invalid motion?
Don’t permit little girl to get sickly-looking
Instrument of the devil
Wicked and mischievous child promises to make recompense
Painful experience in the mouth around edges of denture
Chinese native showing extremes of paranoia
Vulgar set? No
